test_title: PYST 204: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 29th Nov, 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'FAMILY' is written as 'QXBJSD'. How will 'FILMY' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7cc8b186146bd36a26dfaffe7f263736847c53fd027585da4730dc09e352271.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

'FAMILY' is written as 'QXBJSD'.

**The corresponding letter is taken as a code for that letter:**

 
• **F code → Q**
 
• A code → X
 
• M code → B
 
• I code → J
 
• L code → S
 
• Y code → D

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/650b3bd8fb940445b96c7f67b8d948d73794cf5dd38c08e95d22a7700a2a2a20.png] 

Similarly,

'FILMY' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ab47c2f9728fef204f7ae96a2bf22c5ffb1f1523a935ad05ce7c1c2a7249e95.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"QJSBD".**
